scope: One balanced CPU confirmation screen per cached model. Pinned existing revisions. Four P-cores 4–7, GOMAXPROCS=4, 4 kernel workers, one resident model process, fixed 8-token prompt and 7 decode steps.
screen: Exact logits, KV and token IDs in all 24 trials per model. Candidate/baseline single-decode median ratio <=0.95; each of single prefill, two decode and two prefill <=1.05. No forced promotion from one screen.
micro: Existing four-way matrix benchmark with four samples per variant, at 1 and 4 workers. Same exactness and frozen sample ordering as previous direct LUT screen.
followup: If assembly or measurements indicate four-output register pressure, compare a register-fitting tile with the same arithmetic and measure its real-model followup independently. Keep all original results.
